description: Works comprising - demolition of non-original rear two-storey rear extension at lower ground and upper ground floor levels and the development of a replacement two-storey rear extension; - alterations to previously granted planning application PP/18/00799 covering development of a single storey mansard extension at roof level, - enlargement of lower ground floor external rear patio, - internal reconfiguration and refurbishment of the main house across all floor levels, - removal of Ash tree to rear garden, - reconfiguration of existing front and rear garden external finishes, - removal and reconstruction of an external boundary wall and - external facade refurbishment and remedial works where required to the perimeter of the property, covering original stucco, brickwork, windows and drainage goods
